sloka: शत कोटि सहस्राणि लंकायाम् किल रक्षसाम् ।अयुतानि च षट् त्रिंशत् सहस्राणि शतानि च ॥४-३५-१५॥
transliteration: śata koṭi sahasrāṇi laṁkāyām kila rakṣasām ।ayutāni ca ṣaṭ triṁśat sahasrāṇi śatāni ca ॥4-35-15॥

translations.english: 'The number of demons in Lanka is reported to be a hundred thousand crore, three lakh, ninetynine thousand and six hundred. (Note: Indian tradition has numbers up to eighteen digits. One hundred thousand crores is equal to a 'mahapadma' which has thirteen digits. The number described here is 1000000399600.)
translations.hindi: लङ्का में रावण के पास निश्चय हो इस सदय दस खरतर, चार लाख, साठ हजार रासो की सेना हे
